text: 【证监会出手！房企融资“借新还旧”终破冰 房地产发展新模式来了】在受访资深投行保代看来，五大融资举措中对于房地产企业最为直接的利好有二：一是房企债券发行不再局限于已经持续多年的“借新还旧”，而是可以新增发行公司债券用于符合政策要求的房地产项目；二是支持上市房企通过定向增发、定向可转债等方式再融资。第一项措施的推出，标志着房企债券融资在“借新还旧”之外打开了新增发行的空间，符合条件的房企新增发债可行性显著提升。
text_en: [CSRC acts! Real estate financing 'refinancing existing debt' finally breaks through, new development model for property sector arrives] In the view of interviewed senior investment bankers, the two most direct benefits for real estate companies among the five financing measures are: first, corporate bond issuance for developers is no longer limited to the years-long 'refinancing existing debt' model but can include new issuance for projects meeting policy requirements; second, support for listed developers to raise funds via private placements and directional convertible bonds. The first measure marks an opening for additional bond issuance beyond refinancing, significantly boosting the feasibility of new issuance for eligible developers.
